description: Assembly source code implementing AES encryption/decryption routines optimized for ARMv8-A architecture, including key setup, encryption, decryption, CBC mode, and CTR mode functions.

methods.name: aes_hw_set_encrypt_key
methods.description: Sets up the encryption key schedule for AES on ARMv8-A.

methods.name: aes_hw_set_decrypt_key
methods.description: Sets up the decryption key schedule for AES on ARMv8-A.

methods.name: aes_hw_encrypt
methods.description: Performs AES encryption on input data using precomputed key schedule.

methods.name: aes_hw_decrypt
methods.description: Performs AES decryption on input data using precomputed key schedule.

methods.name: aes_hw_cbc_encrypt
methods.description: Performs AES in CBC mode encryption/decryption.

methods.name: aes_hw_ctr32_encrypt_blocks
methods.description: Performs AES in CTR mode for multiple blocks.
